mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_browse_history (user_id, media_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{mediaId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE view_count = view_count + 1, last_viewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_browse_history h JOIN media m ON m.id = h.media_id AND m.status = 1 WHERE h.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT h.user_id, h.media_id, h.view_count, h.last_viewed_at FROM user_browse_history h JOIN media m ON m.id = h.media_id AND m.status = 1 WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY h.last_viewed_at DESC, h.media_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
